title: Optimal Investment and Consumption in Financial Markets with Integrated Variance Clocks
abstract: arXiv:2609.26349v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study the infinite-horizon optimal investment and consumption problem in a general class of continuous financial markets, where uncertainty is driven by a continuous non-decreasing stochastic clock representing accumulated variance. This framework encompasses classical Markovian and non-Markovian stochastic volatility models as well as singular realized-variance models in which no spot volatility process exists. We characterize the value process and optimal investment and consumption strategies in terms of a non-linear infinite-horizon backward stochastic differential equation driven jointly by calendar time and the stochastic clock. We develop a general well-posedness theory for this new class of IVC-BSDEs based on the method of sub- and supersolutions, establishing existence, uniqueness, and stability under natural conditions that might be of independent interest beyond the financial application at hand. translated_title: 具有积分方差时钟的金融市场中的最优投资与消费
translated_abstract: 我们研究了一类一般连续金融市场中的无限期最优投资与消费问题，其中不确定性由一个代表累积方差的连续非减随机时钟驱动。该框架涵盖了经典的马尔可夫与非马尔可夫随机波动率模型，以及不存在即期波动率过程的奇异已实现方差模型。我们通过一个由日历时间和随机时钟共同驱动的非线性无限期倒向随机微分方程来刻画价值过程及最优投资与消费策略。基于上下解方法，我们为这类新型IVC-BSDE建立了一般的适定性理论，在自然条件下证明了其解的存在性、唯一性与稳定性，这些结果在所涉及的金融应用之外也可能具有独立的研究价值。此外，我们还能……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文针对由积分方差时钟驱动的金融市场中无限期最优投资与消费问题，提出了一类新型IVC-BSDE来刻画其价值与最优策略，并利用上下解方法建立了该方程类的存在性、唯一性与稳定性等适定性理论。
en_tdlr: This paper characterizes optimal investment and consumption in general continuous financial markets driven by an integrated variance clock—covering both classical stochastic volatility and singular realized-variance models—via a new class of infinite-horizon BSDEs, for which a general well-posedness theory is developed.
